Elements hidden via inline style="display:none" must not appear in the output

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p>visible</p><div style=\"display:none\">secret hidden text</div><p>also visible</p>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content())
```
